uncertainty: Printed dimensions constrain components, but no complete orthographic assembled drawing is provided. Rear/base alignment, frontal component offset and nose attachment heights are inferred from master render.
Mossy distribution is not recoverable block-for-block from compressed textures. Explicit deterministic patches are recorded, not claimed to be exact printed weathering.
Slab cap is bottom-half to realize 6.5 physical height; bounding matrix is 9 blocks high, not 8.5 cells.
Exploded frontal outline has a subtle side notch that may be perspective/occlusion; six-high frontal plane is retained without inventing a cavity.
No vines/leaves or landscape are exported; they are incidental to the printed component diagram.
state_audit: All stairs face north so their low leading edge projects south; half=bottom, shape=straight, waterlogged=false.
No doors, entities, fluids or block-entity NBT.
